subject: Claude API integration for Acme AI — need enterprise contract by Q2
body:
Hi team,

I'm the CTO at Acme Corp. We're currently evaluating Claude for our AI features and the quality delta is significant — especially on long-context summarization.

We're looking to migrate our AI pipeline to Claude by end of Q2. This would cover:
- AI writing assistant (all users, ~10M+ monthly)
- Q&A over workspace content
- Autofill for databases

We need an enterprise API agreement with committed throughput guarantees. Happy to share exact numbers on a call.

Can we schedule a technical deep-dive this week? Our CEO would join.

Best,
Jane Doe
CTO, Acme Corp

subject: Evaluating Claude for internal ops + potential product features
body:
Hi,

I lead the Engineering team at Globex Corporation (~500 employees). We're exploring two tracks:

1. Internal: our support team handles 1,500+ tickets/week. We want to use Claude to auto-draft responses, classify tickets, and surface knowledge base gaps.

2. Product: our design team is prototyping an AI assistant that could generate code and suggest layouts — Claude's code generation quality caught our attention.

We're comparing Claude, GPT-4o, and Gemini. Our evaluation committee meets March 20th.

Could you send over enterprise pricing and a technical capabilities deck?

Thanks,
John Smith
VP Engineering, Globex Corporation
